BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jun. 29, 2026--[BXP, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bxp.com%2F&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=BXP%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=f95d2ed50fc192cbd6676b373b846002) (NYSE: BXP), the largest publicly traded developer, owner, and manager of premier workplaces in the United States, announced today that it will release financial results for the second quarter 2026 on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, after the close of trading on the NYSE. BXP will host a conference call and webcast on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, at 10:00 A.M. Eastern Time, to discuss the financial results and provide an update on BXP.


Participants who would like to join the call and ask a question may register[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregister-conf.media-server.com%2Fregister%2FBId9f8a75ce55f4add99e54bb4ba607950&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=57c0de73caae92ad54f65aa541b4cf60) to receive the dial-in numbers and a unique PIN to access the call. There will also be a live audio, listen-only webcast of the call, which may be accessed in the Investors section of BXP’s[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bxp.com%2Fevents-webcasts&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=3&md5=fb75efc93b20426eb4b093d339149c4c) .


Shortly after the call, a replay of the call will be available on BXP’s[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bxp.com%2Fevents-webcasts&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=4&md5=fa191ca06906ceaa7996c79f6f33c163) for up to twelve months.


**ABOUT BXP**


[BXP, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bxp.com%2F&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=BXP%2C+Inc.&index=5&md5=9f002f19f6e49f5dcc307ee76c8770f5) (NYSE: BXP) is the largest publicly traded developer, owner, and manager of premier workplaces in the United States, concentrated in six dynamic gateway markets - Boston, Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, and Washington, DC. BXP has delivered places that power progress for our clients and communities for more than 55 years. BXP is a fully integrated real estate company, organized as a real estate investment trust (REIT). As of March 31, 2026, including properties owned by unconsolidated joint ventures, BXP’s portfolio totaled 50.4 million square feet and 164 properties, including six properties under construction/redevelopment. For more information about BXP, please visit our[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bxp.com&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=6&md5=add8becfafc4070e6bf68354f7fd9b0d) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fbxp-inc%2Fposts%2F%3FfeedView%3Dall&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=7&md5=dad66332a25beb1d8fc79016d2c20af3) or[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fbxp_inc%2F&esheet=54562163&newsitemid=20260629828523&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=8&md5=bf79a3c5ed41365aef34fb0f7c5a569b) .
